gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-duru-sans: Wide-spaced, uniform-stroke lettering where capitals barely stand apart. Duru Sans keeps its small letters open and its bodies dominant, while Bushcraft is the one that stays expressive and closed.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-fresca: Expressive and widely spaced, Bushcraft draws every curve at a single stroke. Fresca takes over with a modern, clean feel, its open apertures and short ascenders letting paragraphs run on without strain.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-golos-text: Spaced-out, uniform-stroke lettering up top, then Golos Text in plain sans, its lowercase filling the line and its s parting wide. Bushcraft stays closed and expressive, a sharp foil beside it.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Artistic and widely spaced, Bushcraft draws its curves without any hairline shift. Hedvig Letters Sans brings a wide gap at the c and lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, so it reads approachable.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-heebo: Expressive and widely spaced, Bushcraft draws closed letters with no weight shift in the curves. Heebo comes in with plain sans restraint, a tall central band and curves that stop short instead of closing.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-madurai: Bushcraft spaces its closed, uniform letters far apart. Hind Madurai, a sans-serif, fills each line with wide-open s curves and ribbon-cut stroke ends, so Bushcraft's spaced, closed forms stand out.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara is plain sans with wide gaps at its terminals. Bushcraft is best at closed, expressive shapes spaced far apart, while the body is best at open, tall-bowled e and a forms.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-huninn: Huninn is plain sans with lowercase rising close to cap height and clear s terminals. But Bushcraft, closed and widely spaced with no weight shift, makes a vivid foil.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-karla: Extra-wide spacing between closed, uniform-weight letters defines Bushcraft, whose capitals barely stand out. Karla supplies the counterweight, a gaping c and a tall middle band that make the line look stocky.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-liter: Wide letterspacing is the first thing about Bushcraft, whose closed forms never shift in weight. Liter, in plain sans, brings vertical presence and wide-mouthed round forms where Bushcraft brings expression.
